scripts.start: node tools/generate-docs.mjs && concurrently -k -n gen,docs "node tools/generate-docs.mjs --watch" "ng serve docs"
scripts.build: npm run build:lib && npm run build:docs
scripts.build:lib: cp LICENSE CHANGELOG.md projects/ic-angular-uikit/ && ng build ic-angular-uikit
scripts.start:code-server: node tools/generate-docs.mjs && concurrently -k -n gen,docs "node tools/generate-docs.mjs --watch" "ng serve docs --configuration code-server"
scripts.start:proxy: node tools/generate-docs.mjs && concurrently -k -n gen,build,serve "node tools/generate-docs.mjs --watch" "ng build docs --configuration development,proxy --watch" "node tools/serve-static.mjs 4220 0.0.0.0"
